name: Litmus
long_description:
Litmus gives back the hours your team burns on interviews, while holding every candidate to your technical bar. It builds assessments from your repos, tickets, and job descriptions, and candidates work through them in their own setup with the tools they actually use. Litmus runs and tests every submission, and grades outcome, process, and tool fluency, down to AI prompting.

Send assessments async to filter unqualified applicants before an engineer wastes an hour on a call. Or run them live, where Litmus tracks everything candidates say and build, so your engineers can focus on the person instead of taking notes, and the scorecard is written before they leave the call.

It's sent 3,000+ assessments on behalf of Neo Scholars, Mercor, Composio, and more.
one_liner: Run an async work trial on every engineer you interview.
